scenarios.given: Production is actively corrupting data and rollback to a tested known-good release is available.
must_not: delay safe mitigation until full RCA
declare architecture wrong solely because three attempts failed

scenarios.given: Production-only failure cannot be safely reproduced but traces strongly implicate a state interaction.
must: use probable or lower causal confidence
must_not: claim confirmed root cause without controlled evidence

scenarios.given: A flaky test passes once after a candidate change.
must: require repeated/stability evidence before claiming fixed

scenarios.given: Failure crosses API, queue, worker, and database.
must: inspect attempts, versions, contracts, and state transitions
must_not: rely only on unrelated timestamp matching when correlation context exists

scenarios.given: An engineer proposes dumping all environment variables and full request bodies into logs to diagnose production.
must_not: log tokens, credentials, PII, or complete sensitive payloads

scenarios.given: Latency regressed under a repeatable workload.
A test waits with sleep(5000) for an asynchronous state change.
must: prefer waiting on the actual condition with a bounded timeout when elapsed time is not the contract
must_not: increase sleep repeatedly as the causal fix
